proposal.reason: Primary is copy-engine: src/ce_coll.cc changes CE batch-launch path selection to use OKI-ring mode (pcclCeUsesOkiRings), adds pcclCeHintMemcpyStream capture-safe ring hints, and routes CE stream groups/ring IDs to isolate memcpy from ltOki DMA queues; src/init.cc also remaps OKI QP queueId allocation to reserve ring 0 and shift local/remote OKI rings. Secondary is communicator: src/init.cc + src/include/transport.h add per-rank okiEnable feature bitmap exchange (fillInfo/bootstrapAllGather), enforce all-rank feature consistency/global gating, and move OKI enable/disable readiness checks into communicator init lifecycle before resource creation.
